newsitem.title: USA: Cross Country cuts Homeowners price.
newsitem.headline: Cross Country cuts Homeowners price.

text.p: Homeowners Group Inc said on Thursday that Cross Country Group Inc reduced the acquisition price of Homeowners Group's stock to $2.06 a share.
Cross Country Group was previously going to pay $2.35 a share, the company said in May.
The amended merger terms extend the anticipated closing date to no later than March 1, 1997, Homeowners Group said.
It did not immediately provide a reason for the reduced price.
Under the amended merger terms, a stock rights plan permits Cross Country and its affiliates to buy an unlimited number of shares in privately negotiated transactions.
